newsitem.title: CANADA: Tri Origin, Plutonic join forces.
newsitem.headline: Tri Origin, Plutonic join forces.

text.p: Tri Origin Exploration Ltd said on Thursday it has reached an agreement in principle with Plutonic Resources Ltd of Australia to jointly explore for gold in Nevada.
Plutonic has agreed to fund 80 percent of the first US$15 million of exploration expenditures to hold a 60 percent interest in the joint venture, Tri Origin said.
Tri Origin will hold the other 40 percent interest by funding the remaining 20 percent of exploration.
Tri Origin will act as manager of exploration and in return will receive an administrative cost recovery of 10 percent of direct exploration expenditures, the company said in a statement.
After the first US$1.5 million is spent, the joint venture will be funded 60 percent by Plutonic and 40 percent by Tri Origin.
Plutonic has the option of managing the development and mining phases of the project, Tri Origin said.
